words.zh: n. 戏剧；戏剧性的场面（或情景）；激情；戏剧性事件
words.example: The school drama club will perform a play about a shipwreck next Friday.

words.zh: n. 悲伤；伤心事；歉疚；悲痛；不幸；  v. 感到悲伤；哀痛；为……悲痛
words.example: She expressed deep sorrow for the loss of her old friend.

words.zh: n. 画像，图像；意象，形象的描述；比喻
words.example: The poet's vivid imagery helps readers imagine the cold winter morning.

words.zh: adj. 文学的，文学上的；精通文学的；以写作为职业的；书本上的；书面的；书面语的；爱好文学的；有文学作品特征的
words.example: The novel is considered a literary masterpiece because of its powerful language.

words.zh: n. 押韵短诗；押韵词；押韵的短诗；儿歌，童谣；  v. 押韵
words.example: Can you find a word that rhymes with the last word in this poem?

words.zh: n. 节奏；韵律；格律；规律；【医】节律
words.example: The drummer kept a steady rhythm while the guitarist played the melody.

words.zh: n. 托儿所；保育室；苗圃；育儿室；  adj. 幼儿教育的
words.example: The nursery school teacher read a picture book to the children.

words.zh: n. 童谣；儿歌
words.example: My little sister loves to sing the old nursery rhyme about the moon.

words.zh: adj. 民间的；普通百姓的；民俗的；  n. 大众；亲人，家人；民间音乐；民众；人们
words.example: The folk songs of this region tell stories of hard work and hope.

words.zh: n. 模仿鸟；嘲鸫属鸣禽
words.example: A mockingbird sat on the fence and imitated the songs of other birds.

words.zh: n. 钻石；方块牌；菱形；棒球场的内场；金刚石；【化】金刚石；【数】菱形
words.example: The diamond sparkled under the light as she opened the box.

words.zh: v. 付（款）；  n. 黄铜（器）；铜管乐器；【口语】厚脸皮；高级将领官员；黄铜；【化】黄铜
words.example: The brass section of the orchestra played a bright, majestic tune.

words.zh: n. 公山羊
words.example: The billy goat escaped from the pen and ran into the vegetable garden.

words.zh: n. 公牛，雄性的鲸、象等大动物
words.example: The farmer kept a large bull in the field to protect the cows.

words.zh: vt. 背诵；朗诵，吟诵；列举；  v. 叙述
words.example: Each student had to recite a poem from memory in front of the class.

words.zh: n. 蜜蜂；忙碌的人
words.example: A busy bee buzzed around the clover flowers in the garden.

words.zh: n. 露珠，露滴；水珠
words.example: A tiny dewdrop sparkled on the leaf as the sun rose.

words.zh: n. 黎明；开始；开端；萌芽；  v. 开始；破晓；开始清楚
words.example: We woke up before dawn to watch the sunrise from the hill.

words.zh: n. 三叶草
words.example: The rabbits love to hide among the clover in the field.

words.zh: n. 蝴蝶；蝶泳；  vt. （烹饪时把鱼肉等）切开摊平
words.example: A colourful butterfly landed gently on the blooming cherry blossom.

words.zh: n. 草坪；（衣服用）细麻
words.example: The students sat on the lawn and recited their favourite poems.

words.zh: n. 业余爱好者；外行；  adj. 外行的；业余爱好的
words.example: Even as an amateur, she wrote poems better than many professionals.

words.zh: n. 五行诗
words.example: The cinquain is a five-line poem with a specific syllable pattern.

words.zh: phr. 由……构成，由……组成
words.example: A cinquain is made up of five lines and twenty-two syllables.

words.zh: n. 情绪，心情；氛围；语气
words.example: The soft rain created a calm mood in the classroom.

words.zh: v. 取笑，打趣；挑逗；逗弄；使……渴望；梳理；揶揄；分离，提取；  n. 爱戏弄别人的人
words.example: My brother likes to tease me about my pronunciation.

words.zh: n. 俳句
words.example: We wrote a haiku about autumn leaves and falling rain.

words.zh: n. 音节
words.example: Each syllable in the poem must be pronounced clearly.

words.zh: n. 版式；设计；格式；总体安排；  v. 设计一个版式，设计……的版面；使格式化
words.example: The teacher asked us to follow the format of a traditional haiku.

words.zh: adv. 各自；分别；独自；依次为
words.example: Alice and Ben chose the sonnet and the haiku respectively.

words.zh: adj. 分别的；各自的；【化】各自的，分别的
words.example: After reading, the students returned to their respective seats.

words.zh: v. 开花；兴旺，繁荣；  n. （果树的）花；花簇
words.example: The cherry trees blossom beautifully in early spring.

words.zh: adj. 易碎的，脆弱的；（人）娇弱的，体弱多病的；精美的，精致的；微妙的，需要谨慎处理的；优美的，优雅的；淡雅的；纤细的，细长的
words.example: The poet described the delicate petals with great care.

words.zh: vt. 等候；期待；将发生在；  v. 等待……发生
words.example: A pile of books awaits the students on their desks.

words.zh: vi. （使）旋转；转动；围绕，环绕；  v. 以……为中心
words.example: The plot seems to revolve around the poet's lost childhood.

words.zh: vt. 说；讲；发出；发射；  adj. 完全的；彻底的；无条件的；十足的
words.example: She could not utter a single word after hearing the news.

words.zh: n. 测试；理解力；领悟力；理解练习；理解
words.example: The reading comprehension helped us understand the poem better.

words.zh: n. 架子，搁板
words.example: He placed the poetry anthology on the top shelf.

words.zh: v. 去核；  n. 核心，要点；果心，核；精髓；（物体的）中心部分；核心肌群；【物】核心；  adj. 核心的，主要的；骨干的；必修的
words.example: At the core of the poem lies a feeling of homesickness.

words.zh: n. 樱桃（树）；樱桃色；  adj. 樱桃色的；鲜红色的
words.example: The cherry trees in the yard are full of pink flowers.

words.zh: phr. 樱花
words.example: Every spring we visit the park to see the cherry blossom.

words.zh: adj. （纸等）空白的；茫然的；无图画（或韵律、装饰的）；没表情的；  n. 空白，空白处；空格；  v. 忽视
words.example: Please fill in the blank with the correct word from the poem.

words.zh: n. 诗句，诗节，诗；韵文
words.example: The teacher asked us to memorize the first verse of the poem.

words.zh: n. 平民，百姓；  adj. 平民的，百姓的，民用的；平民的，民用的
words.example: The bomb destroyed many civilian homes during the war.

words.zh: n. 散文；  vt. 用散文写，把…改写成散文；平淡无趣地写；啰啰唆唆地讲
words.example: Her essay was written in prose, not in poetic lines.

words.zh: adj. 有同情心的，同情的；赞同的，支持的
words.example: The teacher was sympathetic to the student who lost her notebook.

words.zh: n. 同情；同感；赞同；慰问
words.example: He showed deep sympathy for the characters in the novel.

words.zh: n. 版本；说法；（某人对于某件事不同于其他人的）描述，说法；译本
words.example: This is the modern English version of an ancient Chinese poem.

words.zh: n. 清白，无罪；天真无邪，单纯；无知，头脑简单；良性
words.example: The poem captures the innocence of a child's first summer.

words.zh: adj. 天真的，单纯的；无辜的，清白的；无恶意的；幼稚的；不懂事的，无知的；无罪的；  n. 天真无邪的人
words.example: The innocent child believed every word of the fairy tale.

words.zh: n. 时代；纪元；年代
words.example: That poem reflects the hopes of the postwar era.

words.zh: n. 通信，通信联系；信件，函件；符合，一致；相似；相关，关联
words.example: The poet kept a long correspondence with her best friend.

words.zh: vi. 相符，一致；相似；通信；相当于；对应，相应
words.example: The haiku's syllables correspond to a fixed pattern.

words.zh: v. 播种；种；散布；煽动（读作/soʊ/）；  n. 母猪（读作/saʊ/）
words.example: Farmers sow seeds in the field during the spring season.

words.zh: v. 播种，结籽；  n. 种子，籽；种子选手；起源；萌芽；【生】种子
words.example: Each seed in the garden grows into a different flower.

words.zh: adj. 主要的，占优势的；显性基因的；统治的，支配的；显著的
words.example: In the poem, the dominant emotion is a deep sense of homesickness.

words.zh: n. 十四行诗
words.example: The teacher asked us to write a sonnet about nature for our poetry class.

words.zh: n. 最后期限
words.example: We must submit our poetry analysis before the Friday deadline.

words.zh: n. 比赛，竞争（读作/ˈkɑːntest/）；竞赛；  v. 争夺，争论（读作/kənˈtest/）；争取赢得（比赛、选举等）；争辩
words.example: She entered a poetry contest and won first prize in the school event.

words.zh: v. 【航】抛光；  vt. 磨光，擦亮；润饰，使优美；抛光；修改；润色；  n. 擦光剂；完美；完善；上光剂；抛光；擦亮；  adj. （Polish）波兰的；（Polish）波兰人的；（Polish）波兰语的（读作/ˈpoʊlɪʃ/）
words.example: Before submitting the poem, I need to polish its rhythm and wording.

words.zh: v. 使紧张；  vt. 串起；悬挂；系；  n. 弦；线；一行；细绳；一系列；一串；条件；【计】字串；【物】线
words.example: He used a piece of string to tie the pages together.

words.zh: conj. 无论在哪里；各处，处处；  adv. （用于问句）究竟在（到）哪里
words.example: You can find inspiration for poetry wherever you look around you.

words.zh: adj. 贫瘠的；不结果实的；不孕的；  n. 荒原，不毛之地
words.example: The barren field offered no hope for the farmer's crops.

words.zh: n. 悲伤，悲痛；悲痛的缘由，伤心事；担心，忧虑
words.example: Her poem expressed deep grief over the loss of a childhood friend.

words.zh: adj. 复杂的；难解的；难懂的；  v. 使复杂
words.example: The rhyme scheme of this poem is too complicated for beginners to follow.

words.zh: n. 变化；[生物] 变异，变种；差异；变奏曲；变化物，变体；【化】变化，变体；【数】变化
words.example: This musical piece is a variation on a famous folk tune.

words.zh: adj. 种族的；人种的
words.example: The novel explores racial prejudice in the American South.

words.zh: n. 偏见，成见；损害，侵害；【法】对合法权益损害；  vt. 使抱有偏见
words.example: We should never judge people with prejudice based on their skin color.
